title: Check Whether Two Strings are Almost Equivalent
summary: Determine if two strings are almost equivalent by comparing the frequency of each letter from 'a' to 'z' in both strings, allowing a difference of at most 3 for each letter.
statement: Determine if two strings are almost equivalent by comparing the frequency of each letter from 'a' to 'z' in both strings, allowing a difference of at most 3 for each letter. Return true if the strings are almost equivalent, otherwise return false.
constraints: Both strings have equal length and contain lowercase English letters.
They are almost equivalent exactly when every letter-frequency difference is at most three in absolute value.
hints: Only per-letter totals matter; character positions do not.
Subtract the second string frequency map from the first and inspect every resulting count.
Return all(abs(delta)<=3 for delta in differences).
The stored delta is exactly count1-count2 for each present letter, while absent letters have delta zero.
